about_short_description.short_description: Maven Bio's AI-driven platform accelerates biopharma deal analysis, enhancing M&A intelligence and strategic decision-making.

product.name: Custom Research Reports
product.description: Generates tailored research reports on BioPharma opportunity areas, including competitive landscapes, pipeline analyses, disease overviews, epidemiology, and FDA label analyses.

identifier.value: AI-Powered Data Tables with AI Columns

product.name: AI-Powered Data Tables with AI Columns
product.description: Creates customized data tables enriched with AI-generated columns that automatically research and populate specific information for each record based on user instructions.

product.name: List Builder
product.description: Enables users to create interactive, filterable lists of BioPharma entities such as companies, drugs, trials, and documents using multiple search criteria.

product.name: Instant AI Answers
product.description: Provides real-time AI-generated answers to specific BioPharma research questions, including in-line citations to original sources.

product.name: Event Monitoring and Event Feeds
product.description: Tracks and curates updates on companies, drugs, and clinical trials, providing timelines and event histories to keep users informed of relevant developments.
